<color=#c0c0c0>For nice screenshots: the character stays in place, the interface and the minimap hide, and the camera flies. Mouse — look, walk keys — move, jump and crouch — up and down, run — three times faster, wheel — speed. F11 — game screenshot (the screenshots folder in the saves). To come back — Esc (or the same key, if you assign one in «Settings» → «Keys» — «Free camera»).\nThis is the mod's own camera, not the console freefly, so achievements are not affected. The world loads around the character: far from it the terrain will be empty. While the camera flies, the character is defenceless — don't use it near enemies.</color>
World map: panel and icons on the large map (M) and on the minimap

<color=#c0c0c0>Open the large map (M): on the right is the «World map» panel with the tabs «Layers» (what to show: places, resources of the whole world, animals), «Search», «Marks», «Drawings» and «Look». All map settings are there, on the map itself.\nPlaces are taken straight from the game, so they are exact for your world. Only the host knows the full list of places: a friend gets the icons if the host has Valheim Helper too. The mod only reads the world's data: it writes nothing into the save and sets no cheat flags.</color>
Teleport from the map: open the map, Ctrl + right click on a point
Reveal the whole map (forever for this character)

Assign a key to any function: click «Assign» and then the key (Esc — cancel).\n<color=#c0c0c0>Nothing is assigned by default. Pick keys the game doesn't use (for example F9–F12 or the numpad), because the game reacts to its own keys too. While you type in the chat, the console or a search field, binds don't fire.</color>
<color=#c0c0c0>If you assign a letter or a digit to the menu, it won't work while you type in the chat or a search field. Esc always closes the menu.</color>
Torches will appear once you enter the world.
Torches and fires of the base

<color=#c0c0c0>Here you see how many torches, sconces, braziers and fires are around, how much fuel it takes to fill them up and how much you have. Refuelling takes fuel from the inventory and gives it to the emptiest first, so even when resin is short as few as possible go out. Torches in dungeons and eternal fires don't count. Items marked «keep» are not used.\nThe game loads buildings only around the player (about 100–150 m), so for a big base stand closer to its centre.</color>

<color=#c0c0c0>The same settings as in the «World modifiers» menu when you choose a world, but right in the game. The game considers a world «cheated» only when it holds values that menu doesn't have (they are set only with the console). Here you can choose only options from the game's menu, and the mod checks every value against its list once more, so achievements are not blocked. The game itself also lets you change modifiers this way with the setworldmodifier / setworldpreset commands without a cheat flag.</color>

<color=#ffb040>Note: achievements tied to combat difficulty (playing on hard or very hard) count only while that difficulty is set. If you lower «Combat», progress of exactly those achievements stops for that time.</color>
